sentence: THE PROPOSED TOLERANCE IS 0.0370 AND THIS CELL RECOMMENDS AGAINST ADOPTING IT AS A TIE-OUT BAR. It is the rule executed faithfully -- the preferred convention's p90 rounded up to the next 5 bp -- but the quantity it is a percentile OF is not a disagreement between two calculations of the same thing: Opal's geometric link EXCLUDES the account-days it withheld while Black Diamond's return covers its full daysHeld, so the difference is dominated by which days each series counts. The clearest case is account 0076459710 over 2026-07-08..2026-08-28, where Opal links 34 of 38 days to +9.1259% against BD's +12.7830% over all 38, and the withheld days include the $1,108,201.80 inception funding. A 2.9-to-3.7% bar on a client-facing return would enshrine that mismatch as acceptable agreement. The preferred convention is equally weak and should be read as UNDETERMINED: END, START and MIDPOINT differ only on flow-bearing days, and of the 10 flow-bearing account-days across these five periods exactly ONE survives into the eligible population, so START's win rests on a single day in a single account and START and MIDPOINT are identical to nine decimals on all five periods. Both findings, their measurements and four candidate remedies are row IRPT_DASHBD-S10, disarm_owner 1.0.0_SA_CTO.
